title: The Elders of the South
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: They are mentioned in [Yevamot 45a](https://www.sefaria.org/Yevamot.45a.5), [Zevachim 22b](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.22b.7) and [Chullin 132b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.132b.6). Hyman considers the reference usually to be the city of Lod, where several of the Tannaim and Amoraim lived: as in [Pesachim 70b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.70b.5), where Yehudah ben Durtai went there; Rabbi Afes, [Eruvin 65b](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.65b.18); Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi; Rabbi Simlai of the South; and many other sages of the generation.[^1]

notes.text: Yevamot gives the Elders of the South as an alternative to Bar Kappara. Pesachim places Yehudah ben Durtai in the south, and Eruvin has the travelers consult Rabbi Afes after referring to the sages of the south. Lod is Hyman’s geographical inference. Heilprin discusses the purity dispute in Zevachim. See [Heilprin’s corresponding entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1161&lang=en).
